headline: Talk Me Down learns to listen — and remember
lede: The defuser's panel now etches the exact calls the mic understands right under the order LCD, and every spoken call — obeyed, refused, or nonsense — is captured into replays alongside the thumbs that followed them.

notes.text: #1415 shipped (#1446): voiceCmd traces land in retrogames-rec v1 captures (obey + refuse-with-why + NO CALL, stamped on the recorder's clock), plus a green/steel call-hint footer on the defuser's LCD rail.

Resumed a dead lane's corpse: slot a went silent 242 min, slot b claimed and audited, slot a woke up and raced the merge — every gate re-run independently on both sides before 35/35 bombcheck + 35/35 bombdrive closed it out.

Prod deploys hide game code in per-game lazy chunks named index-*.js — grepping the app bundle for a feature string reads 0 even when fully deployed. Find the game chunk by a long-standing string first.
A claim is not quiet: post ownership on the issue before building on a reclaimed corpse, and re-check gh pr list on your branch at merge time.
